idea-plugin.name: Mismatched Lock Object Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a synchronized block whose lock object is PROVEN to never be the same as another lock guarding the SAME field elsewhere in the class -- broken mutual exclusion that looks like real thread-safety but isn't. SEI CERT LCK06-J/ LCK00-J; FindBugs has related detectors for this class of bug (bytecode/CI only, not an inline IDE inspection).

Built on real alias analysis proving NON-identity (not identity, the opposite direction of this catalog's own Deadlock Lock-Order Companion): both lock fields are `final`, each initialized to its OWN separate `new` expression -- the strongest guarantee Java offers that two references are never the same object short of full points-to analysis.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only an unqualified lock reference (implicit `this`), and only a field's OWN direct initializer (`private final Object lockA = new Object();`) -- a constructor-assigned field is never treated as provably distinct, a real limitation rather than a guess. No dedicated Marketplace plugin found for this exact angle.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: Field guarded by two provably different lock objects
